protocol.model: shipped 14-feature blend (nfl_season_serve.py feature build), shipped walk-forward protocol (train seasons < s, HL 3, C=100); col 7 v7 = 0 on DEV (participation 2016+); absence/rq cols live from 2013

qb.slice: non-established QB with <8 career starts (one side)
non-established QB with >=8 career starts (one side)
QB differs from last game, not returning starter (one side)
established starter RETURNS after missing last game (one side)
veteran QB new to team (no start for team in last 16) (one side)
both teams: established QB, same as last game

qb_offseason.slice: weeks 1-4: starter != last season's primary QB (one side)
weeks 1-4: both starters = last season's primary QB

coach.slice: new head coach this season, weeks 1-4 (one side)
new head coach this season, weeks 5-17 (one side)

standings_late.slice: weeks 13-17: one team eliminated-proxy (max wins<=8) (one side)
weeks 13-16: one team clinched division (one side)
week 17: one team clinched division (one side)

injury_2009_2015.slice: a QB listed Out/Doubtful (team side) (one side)
STARTING QB listed Q/D (plays hurt) (one side)

margin_info.slice: PD/g diff far BELOW what model implies (bottom 20%)
PD/g diff far ABOVE what model implies (top 20%)

last_game.slice: team won last game by 21+ (one side)
team lost last game by 21+ (one side)

association.var: standings: win pct to date wk5+ (diff)
